reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: This is a false positive due to trust boundary differentiation. The spec (SG-006 L28-29) requires slot validation in the gossip path, which is correctly enforced at data_column_verification.rs:504 via verify_slot_higher_than_parent. The new_for_block_publishing path (L221-250) intentionally skips this check because it operates on data columns derived from already-validated blocks. Code flow: (1) Block submitted via HTTP API undergoes GossipVerifiedBlock::new() which validates block.slot > parent.slot at block_verification.rs:943-948. (2) After validation, build_blob_data_column_sidecars extracts the validated signed_block_header (kzg_utils.rs:175) and embeds it in each DataColumnSidecar. (3) Each column inherits the slot from the pre-validated block header, making re-validation redundant. This is explicitly documented as "for block production ONLY" (L218) and assumes EL-verified cell proofs for locally-constructed blocks. The trust boundary is appropriate: untrusted gossip receives full validation, while locally-constructed or builder-provided blocks are validated at the block level before column construction. No attack path exists to inject invalid slot relationships via this code path. Severity: Informational (by-design architectural decision).
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-006 data_column_sidecar_gossip_validation L28-29 requires slot > parent.slot check for gossip path; implementation correctly distinguishes gossip (untrusted) from block publishing (semi-trusted) paths.
